Short title and commencement

PAKISTAN NAVY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
PAKISTAN NAVY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
6-12-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Navy
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4, Ordinance XXXV of 1961

PAKISTAN NAVY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
PAKISTAN NAVY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2000
ORDINANCE LXII OF
2000
An Ordinance
further to amend the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th December, 2000]
F.No.2(1)/2000-Pub., dated
6-12-2000.---The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4,
Ordinance XXXV of 1961.---In the Pakistan Navy Ordinance, 1961 (XXXV of
1961), hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance in section 4, in clause
(xv), for the words "fourteen years" the words, figures, brackets and
letters "the maximum limit of imprisonment specified in section 57 of the
Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of 1860)" shall be substituted.

Ordinance XXXV of 1961.--In the said Ordinance, in section 78, in
subsection (1), in clause (a), the proviso shall be omitted.

4. Amendment of section 116,
Ordinance XXXV of 1961.--In the said Ordinance, in section 116,---
(a) in
subsection (1), after the words and comma "judge advocate," the words
and comma "the President of the board of inquiry," shall be inserted;
and
(b) for
subsection (3) the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(3) In case of any other
witness the person issuing the summons under subsection (1) shall have the same
powers as a Criminal Court has under the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act
V of 1898), to enforce the attendance of any witness and for his examination or
production of any documents or thing."
